## 0.2.228

owes: a Release now always can carry the engine zip (`synchub-engine-<version>-windows-x64.zip` and a one-line `.sha256`): `release-local.ps1` attaches it last in `Registry` and gains `-Mode Engine -Tag v<version>`, and a new `engine-windows.yml` (`workflow_dispatch`, `workflow_call`) does it for any tag; no hub, image, key or default changes, no migration, rollback safe.
